result.summary: The page looks visually coherent overall: layout is clean, spacing is consistent, and contrast is generally good. Only minor cosmetic issues were found, mostly related to truncated content and low-contrast placeholder text.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel (Trattoria Piccola) is cut off at the right edge of the screen
issues.suggestion: This may be intentional carousel peaking, but ensure the partial card is clearly swipeable, or add a visual affordance (e.g., partial shadow or scroll indicator) to signal more content

issues.description: Search bar placeholder text ('Restaurants, dishes, groceries') is light gray on a light gray background with low contrast
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder text color to improve readability while still distinguishing it from entered text

issues.description: The promo banner's 'min. order €10' condition is small and could be easily missed
issues.suggestion: Consider making the promo conditions slightly more prominent so users notice the minimum order requirement before checkout
